bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to legacy; appropriating money for Fairmont Opera House.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; FAIRMONT OPERA HOUSE.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the Fairmont Opera House for installing roof braces to preserve the oldest operating theater in the state.
